parameters.query: SELECT c.chat_id, c.canal, res ->> 'texto'  AS texto, res -> 'teclado' AS teclado, nullif('{{ $json.editar ?? "" }}', '')::bigint AS editar, CASE WHEN c.canal = 'whatsapp' THEN wa_payload(c.chat_id::text, wa_texto(res ->> 'texto'), res -> 'teclado') END AS wa FROM resolver_plantilla('{{ $json.plantilla }}', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.vars).replaceAll("'","''") }}'::jsonb, '{{ JSON.stringify($json.teclado ?? null).replaceAll("'","''") }}'::jsonb) AS t(res), LATERAL (SELECT ({{ $json.chat_id }})::bigint AS chat_id, canal_de_chat(({{ $json.chat_id }})::bigint) AS canal) c;

SELECT p ->> 'chat_id' AS chat_id, p ->> 'canal' AS canal, p ->> 'mensaje_id' AS mensaje_id, p ->> 'texto' AS texto, p -> 'teclado' AS teclado, CASE WHEN p ->> 'canal' = 'whatsapp' THEN wa_payload(p ->> 'chat_id', wa_texto(p ->> 'texto'), p -> 'teclado') END AS wa FROM (SELECT carga_panel( ({{ $json.panel.sesion_id }})::bigint, '{{ ($json.panel.modo ?? "panel").replaceAll("'","''") }}') AS p) t;
